text.en: Small happenings may hide great human feeling.

Akkarai is a new poem by Kalyanji. New poetry finds paths for living in everyday events: many small events catch our eye but do not reach our heart. The poet picks such neglected, human moments.
The poem invites us to care (அக்கறை) about people and small things around us.
Terms: அக்கறை (concern or care), புதுக்கவிதை, மனிதநேயம் (humanity) and அன்றாடம் (daily).
